headline: Uproar in Parliament as BNP lawmaker comments on women MPs' attire
summary: Lawmaker Monirul Haque Chowdhury's remarks regarding the clothing of Opposition women MPs sparked intense protests during the budget session.
details: Parliament descended into disorder on Sunday during the budget session after BNP lawmaker Monirul Haque Chowdhury made comments about the attire of Opposition women MPs.
The remarks specifically referred to the clothing of women members of Parliament and the wife of Deputy Leader of the Opposition Syed Abdullah Mohammad Taher.
These comments triggered strong protests and heated exchanges among the lawmakers present in the house.
The session was marked by significant tension as members reacted to the statements made by the BNP lawmaker.
Other heated exchanges also occurred in parliament regarding the Home Minister's remarks on a Shibir leader named Zisan.
caption:
A BNP lawmaker's comments on the women MPs' attire sparked an uproar in Parliament.

Parliament descended into disorder on Sunday during the budget session after BNP lawmaker Monirul Haque Chowdhury made comments about the attire of Opposition women MPs.

The remarks specifically referred to the clothing of women members of Parliament and the wife of Deputy Leader of the Opposition Syed Abdullah Mohammad Taher.

These comments triggered strong protests and heated exchanges among the lawmakers present in the house.

The session was marked by significant tension as members reacted to the statements made by the BNP lawmaker.

Other heated exchanges also occurred in parliament regarding the Home Minister's remarks on a Shibir leader named Zisan.

headline_marked: Connolly's 149 helps [[Australia avoid clean sweep]] by Bangladesh
headline: Connolly's 149 helps Australia avoid clean sweep by Bangladesh
summary: Despite a 6-wicket haul from Shoriful Islam, Australia secured a narrow 1-wicket win in the final ODI to avoid a series whitewash, though Bangladesh won the series 2-1.
details: Australia narrowly escaped a series whitewash with a 1-wicket victory over Bangladesh in the final ODI at the Sher-e-Bangla National Cricket Stadium in Mirpur.
Cooper Connolly played a starring role, scoring his maiden ODI century with a massive 149 off 134 balls, including 13 fours and 6 sixes.
The match turned tense in the final overs as Shoriful Islam ripped through the Australian lower order, taking 6 wickets and leaving Australia wobbling after losing 4 wickets for just 5 runs.
Mustafizur Rahman eventually broke Connolly's resistance, but Adam Zampa managed to hit the winning runs to seal the victory.
While Australia won the final match, Bangladesh successfully secured the ODI series win with a final score of 2-1.
caption:
A maiden century and a last-wicket thriller! Australia avoids the whitewash in a nail-biting finish in Dhaka.

Australia narrowly escaped a series whitewash with a 1-wicket victory over Bangladesh in the final ODI at the Sher-e-Bangla National Cricket Stadium in Mirpur.

Cooper Connolly played a starring role, scoring his maiden ODI century with a massive 149 off 134 balls, including 13 fours and 6 sixes.

The match turned tense in the final overs as Shoriful Islam ripped through the Australian lower order, taking 6 wickets and leaving Australia wobbling after losing 4 wickets for just 5 runs.

Mustafizur Rahman eventually broke Connolly's resistance, but Adam Zampa managed to hit the winning runs to seal the victory.

While Australia won the final match, Bangladesh successfully secured the ODI series win with a final score of 2-1.
